sentences.text: On 2 September 1945, in Ba Đình Square in Hà Nội, Hồ Chí Minh read the Declaration of Independence and announced the birth of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam.
The new state had a provisional government and promised an elected National Assembly.
But independence did not bring calm.
A terrible famine had struck the country, and illiteracy was widespread.
Foreign armies also arrived to disarm the defeated Japanese: Chinese Nationalist troops entered the north and British troops the south.
At the same time, France was preparing to return to Indochina.
The young government had to build a state while facing hunger, illiteracy and the threat of a new war.
